name: Sanctora
tagline: The quiet software your congregation runs on
positioning: Sanctora gives solo pastors and small church administrators one calm place to manage members, giving, and the Sunday schedule.

hero.h1: Run your church without the spreadsheet sprawl
hero.sub: Sanctora keeps your membership directory, weekly giving, and volunteer rota in one place — so the person who does everything at your church can finally stop rebuilding the same tabs every Sunday.

features.title: A directory that stays current
features.description: Family groups, contact histories, and pastoral notes in one record. Members update their own details, so your directory stops going stale between Christmas and Easter.

features.title: Giving without the shoebox
features.description: Log envelope, plate, and online gifts against each household, then generate year-end contribution statements in a single afternoon instead of a full week.

features.title: The Sunday rota, solved
features.description: Schedule greeters, readers, and worship teams, send confirmations, and let volunteers swap slots themselves. Fewer 8am 'who's on today?' texts.

features.title: Announcements people read
features.description: Send email and SMS to any group — small groups, new members, the whole parish — from templates that already sound like your church, not a marketing blast.

features.title: Attendance you can trust
features.description: Check-in for services, classes, and children's ministry with printable name tags and simple trend reports for your elder board.

features.title: Your records, your keys
features.description: Encrypted member data, role-based access for staff and volunteers, and a full export button. Sanctora holds your congregation's information in trust, not hostage.

testimonials.quote: I used to spend the last two weeks of December stitching giving totals together from three spreadsheets. This year Sanctora printed every contribution statement in one sitting. I cried a little, honestly.
testimonials.name: Marlene Okafor

testimonials.quote: We're a congregation of 140 with no full-time office staff. Sanctora is the only reason our volunteer rota doesn't collapse the week someone goes on holiday.
testimonials.name: Reverend Tom Halvorsen

testimonials.quote: New families update their own contact cards now, and the directory is finally accurate. Our elders actually trust the attendance reports for the first time in years.
testimonials.name: Priya Sundaram
